facts.value: You are considered a second studies applicant if you have already completed a first undergraduate degree (e.g., Bachelor or state exam) at a German university and are applying for another undergraduate program.
facts.programme_association: American Studies Bachelor | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: In Hesse, no additional fees are charged for a second degree beyond the regular semester contribution.
facts.programme_association: American Studies Bachelor | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: The admission of a master's program after completing a bachelor's degree does not count as a second study.
facts.programme_association: American Studies Bachelor | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: For second studies based on scientific reasons, documents (justification, certificates, etc.) including a cover sheet must be sent by post to the university by June 15 for the winter semester and December 15 for the summer semester.
facts.programme_association: American Studies Bachelor | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: For all other study programs, use the Goethe Campus Portal for application.
facts.programme_association: American Studies Bachelor | Goethe University Frankfurt
American Studies Bachelor | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: For applications to DoSV programs, you must register at hochschulstart.de before online application in the Goethe Campus as you need BID and BAN.
facts.programme_association: American Studies Bachelor | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: After logging in to Goethe Campus, you can go through the online application. Special admission requirements may need to be confirmed depending on the program/subject.
facts.programme_association: American Studies Bachelor | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: If the program is not restricted and the application is submitted on time, it is generally approved.
facts.programme_association: American Studies Bachelor | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: For restricted programs, a selection process occurs: available study places are allocated based on the results of the first degree and reasons for the second study.
facts.programme_association: American Studies Bachelor | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: Points are awarded for both the results of the first degree and reasons for the second study. These points are added to a so-called measurement figure, which is used to sort all applications on a ranking list.
facts.programme_association: American Studies Bachelor | Goethe University Frankfurt
